clips.title: The story
paras: Deathguard Bartholomew is a vigilant Forsaken soldier stationed in the town of Brill. Tasked with maintaining security across Tirisfal Glades, he helps travelers navigate the blighted settlement and assists in enforcing discipline among local defenders.

Standing watch in the settlement of Brill, Deathguard Bartholomew represents the stalwart military backbone of the Forsaken. Like his fellow Deathguards throughout Tirisfal Glades, he defends reclaimed territory from lingering Scourge, fanatical Scarlet Crusaders, and any other threats to Lady Sylvanas's domain. In addition to keeping watch, he provides directions to travelers attempting to navigate the town's facilities and participates in maintaining orderly conduct among the newly risen.
